lessons.finding: Saved approval, attempted execution, provider receipt and human outcome are separate states. Chief and specialist bots need an explicit next step for each state.

An appointment can be saved while calendar synchronization is pending; a payment cannot establish membership; local inbox or membership review completion is not an external action. Preserve those distinctions through handoffs and reopened work.

Shared with the Scribe and Research teams: current source evidence and exact saved downstream evidence must remain linked. A changed note or expired scheduling proposal must prompt review instead of preserving an apparently actionable old approval.

A lost scheduling or payment response is not proof of failure. Recover the existing operation or seek its receipt; never recommend creating another booking or payment because the first response was lost.

Native Chief resolves only saved work links and follow-up receipts. A withdrawn link remains visibly unavailable rather than disappearing or exposing cached private details; status reads never approve or repeat an operation.
